state.semantics: Fresh four-hour planning deadline. Actual completion requires 10,800 durable active learning seconds; safety/operator and individual job guards remain in force.

preregistered_protocol.selection: Primary gates use paired raw outcomes against the exact frozen approach baseline. Both mixed training seeds must pass at the same midpoint for a matched extension. Sequential arms measure the curriculum contrast. Late eligibility adds replicated true switch exit gains on at least two geometric layouts. The local proxy is descriptive only and has no official scoring interpretation.

retention-low.hypothesis: Half original learning rate on persistent mixed practice

retention-anchor.hypothesis: Moderate warm-policy distillation on fresh mixed rollouts

retention-safe.hypothesis: Lower learning-rate fallback using the same moderate anchor

retention-distill.hypothesis: Transfer only the lock-opening head from the BC-PPO teacher, retaining the warm policy elsewhere

memory-control.hypothesis: Matched feedforward control for fresh-Adam memory forks

occupancy.hypothesis: Ego-centric occupancy memory with parity-preserving initialization

count.hypothesis: Bounded coverage-based novelty on course rewards

mastery.hypothesis: Preserve all skills while adapting map families in a mixed course pool
